EN: It says that lead is denser than iron, but a pound of lead and a pound of iron weigh exactly the same!
ZH: 书里说铅的密度比铁大，但一磅铁却和一磅铅一样重！

EN: How can this be?
ZH: 怎么可能呢？

EN: You're the scientist. Figure it out!
ZH: 你是科学家。你自己想啊！

EN: Density has nothing to do with weight.
ZH: 密度和重量没关系。

EN: We don't know, and we don't care.
ZH: 我们不知道，我们也不在乎。

EN: I don't need your nay-saying! Just get out of here! Leave me to my work.
ZH: 我不需要听你们这些废话！赶紧走开！让我一个人工作。

EN: What? Of course! It's so obvious now! Here. A stipend for your insights.
ZH: 什么？对哦！现在就很明显了！来，这是给你的奖励。

EN: Insults? Hmph. Fine. Leave me alone then.
ZH: 埋汰我？好，行。你们走吧，我自己来。

EN: Excellent, the new researchers from the Vault!
ZH: 好极了！来自避难所的新研究员！

EN: I'm studying the conversation of matter through the rigorous process of boiling water.
ZH: 我正在通过严密的烧水过程研究物质的交换。

EN: But the water goes away when boiled! How can this be? Matter can't be destroyed.
ZH: 但烧水之后水就没了！这是为什么，物质不会被摧毁的啊。

EN: That's what you're studying? How is boiling water supposed to help anyone?
ZH: 这就是你研究的东西？烧开水能有什么用？

EN: The water isn't being destroyed. It's changing from a liquid to a gas.
ZH: 水没有被摧毁啊。只是从液态变成了气态。

EN: Maybe it just doesn't like your stupid face.
ZH: 也许它只是不喜欢你那张蠢脸。

EN: If your stomach can't stand the science, get out of the lab!
ZH: 如果你的心容不下科学，那请你滚出我的实验室！

EN: An interesting theory! Thank you. Here. Have something for your trouble.
ZH: 有趣的理论！谢谢你。来拿着，遇到麻烦的时候可以用它。

EN: Are you saying you're... cannibals? Um... maybe you should just go.
ZH: 你是说你们……吃人？呃……你们还是走吧。

EN: I'm afraid you're too late, Vault Dwellers. My patient is dead...
ZH: 我恐怕你们来得太迟了。我的病人已经死了……

EN: Just kidding! He was already dead! For a while actually. Not a great smell...
ZH: 只是开玩笑！他早就死了，有好一会的，味道不太……

EN: I wonder why bodies never smell so bad when the person is alive?
ZH: 我很好奇，为什么人活着的时候尸体闻起来就没那么臭呢？

EN: This is most disgusting conversation we've ever had.
ZH: 这是我经历过的最恶心的谈话。

EN: Well, one reason is that the body isn't alive anymore to fight off bacteria and fungus.
ZH: 这个嘛，一个是因为身体死了，所以没法抵御细菌和真菌的侵害。

EN: If you think the smell is bad, you don't want to know about the taste.
ZH: 如果你觉得这气味已经很难闻了，那吃起来什么味道，你更不会想知道了。

EN: Uh, yes. Well, I should get back to work...
ZH: 啊，是啊。那，我应该回去工作了……

EN: Fascinating! I'll need to write this down. Here. Take this for your help!
ZH: 真厉害！我要把这个写下来。来拿着，这个可以帮助你们！

EN: That's... Not really what I was hoping to discover. Oh well. I should be on my way.
ZH: 那个……并不是我想发现的东西。但无论如何，我该上路了。

EN: You're just in time. I'm in the middle of a most interesting quandary.
ZH: 你们来得真及时。我正陷入了一场很有意思的困境。

EN: Plants require light to grow, but mushrooms don't! They grow even in total darkness.
ZH: 植物需要光来生长，但蘑菇不需要！它们甚至能在完全黑暗的环境下生长。

EN: But why is that? Don't all living things need light?
ZH: 但这是为什么呢？难道不是所有的生物都需要光的吗？

EN: The only light you need is the shine from our amazing brilliance!
ZH: 你只需要我们聪明的大脑带来的灵光！

EN: Plants make food from light, but mushrooms get their nutrients from dissolving molecules.
ZH: 植物通过光获取营养，但蘑菇是靠分解分子。

EN: We don't know about light, but we're confident all living things can be set on fire.
ZH: 我们不知道光，但我们很确信所有的生物都可以着火！

EN: A group of scientists have asked for our help. They're in a dangerous area out in the Wasteland.
ZH: 一群科学家请求你的帮助。他们处在废土的危险区域。

EN: Science Cooperative!
ZH: 科学合作！

EN: Talk to the scientists.
ZH: 和科学家交谈。

EN: Talk to the scientists.
ZH: 和科学家交谈。

EN: Send your Dwellers out to aid scientists in the Wasteland.
ZH: 派你的居民去废土上帮助科学家们。

EN: We'll see about that!
ZH: 我们等着瞧！

EN: You ain't getting nothing from me!
ZH: 休想从我这得到什么！

EN: Okay, I can respect that. But I'm still gonna kill you!
ZH: 好的，我尊重这点，但你们还是得死。

EN: Yeah, well you'll leave in pieces!
ZH: 没错，你们会碎成渣！

EN: Why are you doing this? We ain't done nothing to you!
ZH: 为什么要这么做，我们又没对你怎么样！

EN: The future's a lot brighter without you in it!
ZH: 没有你在，未来会变得光明许多！

EN: Give me your clothes, your boots, and your motorcycle...
ZH: 给我你的衣服，你的鞋子，还有你的摩托车……

EN: We... Got bored?
ZH: 我们……觉得无聊了？

EN: We come in peace!
ZH: 我们是为和平而来！

EN: Cutting-edge science requires materials and demands sacrifice. So sacrifice some Raiders in the name of Science and take all their stuff!
ZH: 前沿科技需要材料和相应的牺牲。所以以科学之名牺牲掉几个掠夺者，并拿走他们的东西吧！

EN: Scientific Progress
ZH: 科学进步

EN: Explore the building.
ZH: 探索建筑。

EN: Kill the Raider Boss.
ZH: 消灭掠夺者首领。

EN: Don't let anything stand in the way of Science!
ZH: 任何事都无法阻挡科学之路！

EN: Oh, no! It's the Institute!
ZH: 哦，不！是学院！

EN: “Mankind, Redefine” THIS, jerks!
ZH: “人类，重新定义”这个，混蛋们！

EN: It's a contest. The Commish gives it to the nastiest Raider, and there's nobody nastier than me!
ZH: 这是个比赛。“总裁”将把它交给最歹毒的掠夺者。没有人比我还歹毒了！

EN: He's the big, bad boss who awards the Super Cup to the nastiest Raider. Like me!
ZH: 他就是那个大坏蛋老板，奖励给最歹毒的掠夺者“超级杯”！比如说我！

EN: You're too late! I sent that settler to the Commish!
ZH: 你太迟了！我把那个定居者送去“总裁”那儿了！

EN: They're gonna be our new cheerleader, heh heh.
ZH: 他们将会是我们新的拉拉队，呵呵。

EN: I'm gonna win this year's Super Cup for sure!
ZH: 我一定会赢得今年的“超级杯”！

EN: What is this Super Cup?
ZH: 这个超级奖杯是什么东西？

EN: Who's the Commish?
ZH: 谁是“总裁”？

EN: A gang of Raiders has taken a settler hostage. Rescue the captive and solve the mystery of the Super Cup!
ZH: 一群掠夺者们绑架了一位定居者做人质。拯救人质并解开“超级杯”之谜！

EN: Second-Stringers
ZH: 替补队员

EN: Locate the hostage.
ZH: 找到人质。

EN: Learn about the Super Cup
ZH: 了解“超级杯”

EN: Locate the hostage.
ZH: 找到人质。

EN: Blitz 'em!
ZH: 闪电战！

EN: You're goin' on injured reserve!
ZH: 你上了伤病储备名单！

EN: Secret Agent Person
ZH: 秘密特工人员

EN: Fine, we'll just take it then!
ZH: 好吧，那我们就拿去吧！

EN: How about no?
ZH: 没门！

EN: Well, you're in a bit of a pickle then, 'cause we all saw you.
ZH: 好吧，那你就有点麻烦了，因为我们都看见你了。

EN: That's some fancy weaponry you got there, buddy.
ZH: 你的武器很炫嘛，伙计。

EN: Tell you what. You give it to us, and we'll let you live.
ZH: 告诉你。你把它给我们，我们会让你活下去。

EN: I'm sorry, I can't do that.
ZH: 对不起，我不能那样做。

EN: How about I kill you instead, and we forget the whole thing?
ZH: 我们杀了你，然后忘了整件事怎么样？

EN: My orders are clear: no witnesses.
ZH: 我的命令是明确的：没有证人。

EN: Among the documents retrieved from the Raider base were plans for a new weapon. Our engineers have built it, but now we need to test the weapon out in the field to see how well it performs. Make sure no one sees you and lives to tell about it.
ZH: 从掠夺者基地检索的文件中有一个新武器计划。我们的工程师已经造好了它，但现在我们需要实地测试下，看看它的表现如何。确保没有活着的人看到你。

EN: Secret Weapon Test
ZH: 秘密武器试验

EN: Test the Junk Jet on enemies.
ZH: 在敌人身上测试垃圾喷射炮。

EN: Test the weapon built from recovered blueprints.
ZH: 测试从发现的蓝图上建造出的武器。

EN: Let's see what this baby can do!
ZH: 让我们看看这个宝贝能做什么！

EN: Say hello to my not-so-little friend!
ZH: 向我不那么小的朋友问好！

EN: Got Junk? Here's more!
ZH: 有杂物吗？这里有更多！

EN: Forget that! It's eatin' time!
ZH: 忘了那个！进食时间到了！

EN: Why are you Pests here, in this bastion of starvation?
ZH: 为什么你们这些“害虫”在这里，在这个充满饥饿的堡垒里？

EN: You'll only find sickly, emaciated husks to whom you are exalted succor.
ZH: 你只会发现虚弱、瘦削的躯壳，对它们来说你是尊贵的救星。

EN: Woeful creatures whose psyches construct elaborate ruses to eschew reality.
ZH: 可悲的生物，他们要挖空心思编造诡计，以逃避现实。

EN: E.g., I... become... a... walking thesaurus? (Looks confused.)
ZH: 比如，我……成为……一个……行走的同义词典吗？(看起来困惑。)

EN: We don't want to fight. We just have a message for the leaders of the Hungry.
ZH: 我们不想打架。我们只是给“饥饿”的头目们捎个口信。

EN: Well don't give up! You're the only ones left who can stand up to the Horsemen!
ZH: 好吧，别放弃！你是唯一活着的，可以对抗骑士的人！

EN: Hi! It's me, Drusilla, the archivist from the Vault-Tec Archives.
ZH: 你好！是我，德鲁西拉，来自避难所科技档案馆的档案管理员。

EN: I figured I could safely come here and see what the fuss is about.
ZH: 我想我可以安全地到这里来看看这是怎么回事。

EN: These Hungry really have one-track minds. That said, I'm feeling a bit peckish myself...
ZH: 这些饥肠辘辘的人真是一根筋。话说回来，我自己也有点饿了……

EN: Did you ever end up finding Death's cave?
ZH: 你曾经找到过“死亡”之洞穴吗？

EN: No, it could be anywhere. Meanwhile, Vault 144 is still busy trying to wake Death up.
ZH: 没有，那可能在任何地方。同时，144号避难所仍在忙着唤醒“死亡”。

EN: Oh, he'll make it all right, and he'll be eating *all* the food!
ZH: 哦，他会没事的，他会把“所有”的食物都吃光的！

EN: How about a story before dinner?
ZH: 晚饭前讲个故事怎么样？

EN: “Combine Pests with basil, garlic, Parmesan cheese, olive oil and pine nuts.”
ZH: “将害虫与罗勒、大蒜、帕尔马干酪、橄榄油和松仁混合。”

EN: “Blend to a smooth paste. Season to taste.”
ZH: “调合成细致的糊状。加佐料然后品尝。”

EN: Voila! Pest-o sauce!
ZH: 瞧！害虫酱！

EN: Hold it! Pestilence will soon be fighting War in Vault 226. Can Famine make it to the party?
ZH: 慢着！“瘟疫”很快就要在226号避难所和“战争”开打了。“饥荒”能赶来参加派对吗？

EN: The Pests will bring Pestilence to Vault 226, so War is sure to follow. If we could get Famine there as well, the Horsemen and their cultists might all take care of each other! We need to dress as Pests and speak to the Hungry Horde's non-feral leaders.
ZH: “害虫”将把“瘟疫”带到226号避难所，因此战争肯定会接踵而至。如果我们也能让“饥荒”在那儿出现，骑士和他们的信徒就可以自相残杀了！我们需要装扮成“害虫”，和“饥饿”部落不那么野蛮的头领们谈谈。

EN: Set 'Em Up: Famine
ZH: 埋伏设计：“饥荒”

EN: Get the Hungry to lead Famine to Vault 226.
ZH: 让“饥饿”的人将“饥荒”引到226号避难所。

EN: Talk to Drusilla.
ZH: 与德鲁西拉交谈。

EN: Lure Famine to the abandoned Vault 226.
ZH: 把“饥荒”引诱到废弃的226号避难所。

EN: Let our hunger consume you!
ZH: 让我们的饥饿吞噬你！

EN: You Pests are all red meat!
ZH: 你们这些害虫都是红肉！

EN: What would Famine do? Why, eat you, of course!
ZH: 饥荒会怎样？当然是吃了你！

EN: Let's put an end to this hunger strike!
ZH: 让我们结束这场饥肠辘辘的侵扰吧！

EN: Just as well. I don't actually have a parlor.
ZH: 不要紧。我并没有客厅。

EN: You Warshippers shouldn't have come here.
ZH: 你们这些“战狂”不应该来这里。

EN: But I have one question before we kill you.
ZH: 但在杀你之前我有一个问题。

EN: Will you walk into my parlor?
ZH: 你能走进我的客厅吗？

EN: We're already here, actually, and we have a message for whoever's in charge.
ZH: 事实上我们已经在这儿了，我们有话要对负责人说。

EN: You have to help me! I was undercover for the Weekly Exposition, but they found me out.
ZH: 你得帮帮我！我是每周博览会的卧底，但他们发现了我。

EN: They dosed... no, blessed... me with... Pestilence's... radiation...
ZH: 他们给我服……不，赐予了我……“瘟疫”的……辐射……

EN: I can't... think straight... Blessed... be... Blessed be... the irradiated!
ZH: 我不能……思考……受祝福的……是……受祝福的……被辐射的人！

EN: I... am... un... No! I AM NOW WORTHY!
ZH: 我……我……呃……不！我现在值得！

EN: Uh... Eagle?
ZH: 嗯……鹰吗？

EN: Fine by us. Pestilence will be there to start culling the herd... of Horsemen!
ZH: 我们没问题。“瘟疫”将会开始扑杀这群……骑士！

EN: All we want is to spread Pestilence's glory throughout the Wasteland.
ZH: 我们所要的，无非是要把“瘟疫”的荣光，传遍废土。

EN: Is that really too much to ask?
ZH: 这真的要求太多了吗？

EN: So for the love of Pestilence, would you *please* give us a break?
ZH: 所以，看在“瘟疫”的份上，能“请”您让我们歇一会吗？

EN: Sure, but War, may he live forever, is calling Pestilence out. One-on-one in Vault 226.
ZH: 当然，但是“战争”……愿他长生不老，他正在召唤“瘟疫”。在226号避难所单挑。

EN: The truce forgotten, War is now out for blood, ready to tear the Wasteland apart looking for Pestilence! The longer it takes, the more innocent Settlers will die, so let's dress as Warshippers and convince the Pests to bring Pestilence to War. Vault 226, abandoned and in the mountains, will make a great arena for their apocalyptic faceoff!
ZH: 停战协议被遗忘，“战争”现在外面猎取鲜血，准备撕裂废土寻找“瘟疫”! 时间拖得越久，无辜的定居者就会死得越多，所以让我们装扮成“战争崇拜者”的人，说服“害虫”把“瘟疫”拉进战争。群山里被遗弃的226号避难所，将成为他们末日对决的大竞技场！

EN: Set 'Em Up: Pestilence
ZH: 埋伏设计：“瘟疫”

EN: Get the Pests to lead Pestilence to Vault 226.
ZH: 让“害虫”把“瘟疫”带到226号避难所去。

EN: Talk to the Weekly Exposition reporter.
ZH: 与每周博览会记者交谈。

EN: Lure Pestilence to the abandoned Vault 226.
ZH: 引诱“瘟疫”到被遗弃的226号避难所。

EN: Blessed be the irradiated!
ZH: 愿辐射保佑我们！

EN: Worthiness is overrated!
ZH: 价值被高估了！

EN: After we kill you, Pestilence will glow... with pride!
ZH: 我们杀了你，“瘟疫”会因骄傲而闪闪发光！

EN: I agree with the criticisms leveled at our organization's name!
ZH: 我同意对我们组织名称的批评！

EN: Nope. Nada. Nothing.
ZH: 不，没，什么都没有。

EN: Does Coach really have the Jersey? Evidence suggests he may be in an old office building, so it's worth a look.
ZH: 教练真的有棒球衫吗？有证据说他可能在一幢旧的办公大楼里。最好去看看。

EN: Seventh Inning Stretch
ZH: 棒球第七局

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Hunt Coach down in an office building.
ZH: 在办公楼里找到教练。

EN: Well, that's disappointing.
ZH: 好吧，那太令人失望了。

EN: Clover sprigs are supposed to have three leaves only...
ZH: 三叶草或者是应该只有三片叶……

EN: ...but all the samples here have four leaves. Must be a different plant.
ZH: 但是这里所有的样品都有四片叶子。肯定是不同的植物。

EN: What rotten luck. Come on, let's go home.
ZH: 真是倒霉透顶！走，我们回家吧。

EN: We've received information that Vault 317 contains clover samples from before the Great War. This hardy, nutritious weed, believed to be extinct, could prove an important staple for us. We need to bring back these samples - if there are any left!
ZH: 我们已经收到信息，317号避难所有战前的三叶草样品。这种耐寒，营养丰富的杂草，据说已经灭绝了，现在证明可以是我们重要的主食。如果有的话，我们需要把这些样品带回来！

EN: Shamrock the Casbah
ZH: 三叶草城堡

EN: Explore Vault 317
ZH: 探索317号避难所

EN: Retrieve clover samples from an abandoned Vault.
ZH: 从废弃的避难所中找到三叶草样本。

EN: Top o' the mornin' to ya!
ZH: 早上好哟！

EN: I wouldn't mind some green beer just about now...
ZH: 我现在不介意喝点绿啤酒……

EN: Erin go Bragh!
ZH: 爱尔兰万岁！

EN: Get me out of here!
ZH: 放我出去！

EN: A love-struck Raider boss has decided to get married, even though his bride-to-be wants no part of it. Save the kidnapped beauty from the clutches of her unwanted groom.
ZH: 一位被爱情冲昏头脑的掠夺者首领决定要结婚了，即使新娘完全不愿意。请把这位被绑架的美人，从她那个她根本不想要的未婚夫的魔爪中救出来。

EN: Shotgun Wedding
ZH: 逼婚

EN: Rescue the kidnapped Vault Dweller.
ZH: 拯救被绑架的避难所居民。

EN: Defeat the Raider Boss.
ZH: 打败掠夺者首领。

EN: Rescue the kidnapped Vault Dweller from the Raider Boss.
ZH: 从掠夺者首领手中拯救被绑架的居民。

EN: You won't be crashin' this wedding!
ZH: 你们休想破坏这个婚礼！

EN: Look at that. An old note. Gosh. It looks pre-war.
ZH: 快看那个，一张旧的便条，感觉像是战前的。

EN: “Received our Mr. Handy today. We're going to need to get this thing up and running quick if we're going to get the repairs done in time.”
ZH: “今天我们的巧手先生到了。要想按时把维修做完，就得赶紧让这家伙运转起来。”

EN: Ah ha. Another note.
ZH: 啊哈，又是一张字条。

EN: “Repairs are taking longer than expected. I'm going to get everyone into the lower levels. Hopefully we'll all be safe down there.”
ZH: “修理的时间比我们预计的要长。我要把所有人都带到下面几层去，但愿我们在那儿能安全。”

EN: Oh gosh...
ZH: 哦天啊……

EN: This appears to be the source of the signal. And there's another note.
ZH: 这里好像就是信号源。那里还有一张字条。

EN: “The door. It won't seal. I'm turning on the distress beacon. Maybe someone will help us. Otherwise... it's only a matter of time before the radiation gets us all.”
ZH: 门……关不上。我打开了求救信标，也许会有人来帮我们。不然的话……我们迟早都会被辐射拖垮。

EN: Those Ghouls... they were the Vault Dwellers... what have I done?
ZH: 这些尸鬼……他们本来是避难所居民……我到底做了什么？

EN: Hey, is that a Mr. Handy? All right!
ZH: 嘿，那是一个巧手先生吗？太棒了！

EN: You've picked up a distress signal emanating from the supposedly abandoned Vault 233. It's up to you to investigate.
ZH: 你收到了一个求救信号，来自本已废弃的233号避难所。去调查看看吧。

EN: Signal Failure
ZH: 信号失败

EN: Find the source of the Vault 233 distress signal.
ZH: 找到233号避难所求救信号的源头。

EN: Follow up on the old distress signal emanating from Vault 233!
ZH: 查看233号避难所发出的求救信号。

EN: Hey! We got here first! No one's looting this Vault but us!
ZH: 嘿！我们是第一个到这里的！还没有人搜刮过这个避难所呢！

EN: No, just save the rest of my team. They're trapped in Vault 390.
ZH: 不用，只要去救我们小队剩下的人就行。他们被困在了390号避难所。

EN: You're too late. I was once a Scribe with Maxson's Roughnecks... but the radiation did this to me.
ZH: 你们来得太迟了。我曾是“麦克森硬汉小队”的学士……但辐射让我变了样子。

EN: I'm so sorry. Can I help?
ZH: 真是太可怜了。有什么我能帮你的吗？

EN: One of Maxson's Roughnecks told me his team went to clear out a Nuka-Cola Plant. Looks like that's the next stop on my hunt.
ZH: “麦克森硬汉小队”的一员告诉我他的队伍去清理核子可乐工厂了。看来这就是我们下一站的目的地。

EN: Slash and Burn
ZH: 刀耕火种

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
ZH: 消灭发光种。

EN: Explore the Nuka-Cola Plant.
ZH: 探索核子可乐工厂。

EN: Search the Nuka-Cola Plant for Maxson's Roughnecks.
ZH: 前往核子可乐工厂，寻找“麦克森硬汉小队”。

EN: There's a box of stale Sugar Bombs, but no Jersey.
ZH: 有一盒过期的糖衣炸弹麦片。但没有棒球衫。
